inputs.xtext_rule_text:
fragment ViewBodyItem returns SysML::ViewUsage :
	  DefinitionBodyItem
	| ownedRelationship += ElementFilterMember
	| ownedRelationship += Expose
	| ownedRelationship += ViewRenderingMember
;

decision: SysML 8.2.2.26.2 states ViewBodyItem : ViewUsage = DefinitionBodyItem | ownedRelationship += ElementFilterMember | ownedRelationship += ViewRenderingMember | ownedRelationship += Expose. The SysML Xtext has the same four alternatives with Expose before ViewRenderingMember; order does not change the language. The rule is the clause as written.
